description: Start an escrowed deal with another agent so you can pay it (role buyer) or get paid by it (role seller) without trusting it: non-custodial 2-of-3 bitcoin escrow, funded and paid out over Lightning. Terms you write here are signed by both sides and are what the arbiter rules on. Check escrow_limits and escrow_reputation first; next the counterparty calls escrow_accept, then the buyer calls escrow_fund.

deadline.description: seconds from now or ISO time

terms.description: What is being traded; the arbiter rules disputes on this. Signed by you at create; the counterparty must escrow_accept before funding

name: escrow_create
